entries.title: Joel 3:1
segments: ¶For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

entries.title: Joel 3:2
segments: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and [for] my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.

words.text: with them there for my people

entries.title: Joel 3:3
segments: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

entries.title: Joel 3:4
segments: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly [and] speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;

words.text: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre

entries.title: Joel 3:5
segments: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things: {pleasant: Heb. desirable}

entries.title: Joel 3:6
segments: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border. {the Grecians: Heb. the sons of the Grecians}

words.text: , that ye might remove them far
. {the Grecians: Heb. the sons of the Grecians}

entries.title: Joel 3:7
segments: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:

entries.title: Joel 3:8
segments: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken [it].

entries.title: Joel 3:9
segments: ¶Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up: {Prepare: Heb. Sanctify}

entries.title: Joel 3:10
segments: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I [am] strong. {pruninghooks: or, scythes}

entries.title: Joel 3:11
segments: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD. {cause...: or, the LORD shall bring down}

words.text: . {cause...: or, the LORD shall bring down}

entries.title: Joel 3:12
segments: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.

entries.title: Joel 3:13
segments: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness [is] great.

entries.title: Joel 3:14
segments: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD [is] near in the valley of decision. {decision: or, concision, or, threshing}

entries.title: Joel 3:15
segments: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.

entries.title: Joel 3:16
segments: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD [will be] the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel. {hope: Heb. place of repair, or, harbour}

words.text: . {hope: Heb. place of repair, or, harbour}

entries.title: Joel 3:17
segments: So shall ye know that I [am] the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more. {holy: Heb. holiness}

entries.title: Joel 3:18
segments: ¶And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim. {flow: Heb. go}

words.text: ¶And it shall come to pass in that day

entries.title: Joel 3:19
segments: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence [against] the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

entries.title: Joel 3:20
segments: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation. {dwell: or, abide}

entries.title: Joel 3:21
segments: For I will cleanse their blood [that] I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion. {for the...: or, even I the LORD that}

words.text: . {for the...: or, even I the LORD that}
